result_fields.failure: owned fixed diagnostic string or empty string
result_fields.rows: fixed 57 Row objects in batchprep.Schedule order
result_fields.Observe_calls_returned: integer 0..57; includes an Observe return that refused candidate dispatch
result_fields.scope: fixed scope description; no source bodies or argument values

Header.plan_sha256: 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters of exact future sealed plan bytes

Counters.candidate_reserved: integer 0..57; intent before a successful checkpoint
Counters.candidate_dispatched: integer 0..57; owned wrapper entered after checkpoint success
Counters.checkpoint_stopped: boolean; sticky failure stops later dispatch

counter_conservation: owned counters do not instrument upstream internal, getter, setup or init calls

Row.attempted: boolean; Observe callback invocation attempted, not a claim that a candidate executed
Row.observation: original batchprep.Observation object or null when not started

Frame.sequence: proposed next event sequence; in-memory successful count advances only after file.Sync returns; row presence alone is not an acknowledgment
Frame.previous_record_sha256: empty for first frame; SHA256 of entire previous exact frame including LF thereafter
Frame.event: Event, with original field casing preserved

Event.Partial: PartialObservation: immutable scalar, string and fixed-array value snapshot

snapshot_representations.TextField: {Known:bool, Nil:bool, Value:string}; unobserved differs from observed null
snapshot_representations.MapSnapshot: {Known:bool, Nil:bool, Count:int, Entries:[24]{key,value}}; ordered logical prefix and unused zero entries
snapshot_representations.before_error_method: CandidateCompletionObserved/ReturnedNormally true; known return values/state, ErrorPresent and ErrorType; ErrorText/ErrorKind unknown; no upstream error interface escapes
snapshot_representations.after_error_method: ErrorMethodCompletionObserved true; either observed error text/kind or ErrorMethodPanicked with text still unknown
snapshot_representations.after_candidate: candidate completion recorded, with measured null error channels distinguished from unobserved panic/error text channels
snapshot_representations.ownership: the Event copied by value and serialized synchronously contains no map, slice, pointer, upstream error interface or callback

DurableState.events_synced: number of frames whose complete write and file.Sync returned success
DurableState.completed_dispatches: number of after_candidate frames successfully synced
DurableState.last_record_sha256: last successful full-frame digest, or empty
DurableState.last_event: last successfully synced Event; zero value before first checkpoint
DurableState.physical_bytes_written_before_final: actual successful or partial reservation/journal Write bytes before final serialization; not final-file bytes and not allocator/RSS
DurableState.failure: first owned fixed diagnostic, or empty

output_protocol.reservation.json: O_EXCL; initial zero candidate counts; file.Sync then child-directory Sync then parent-directory Sync before a usable writer is returned
output_protocol.checkpoints.jsonl: O_EXCL; one compact JSON frame plus LF per event; failed or in-flight suffix is not claimed durable
output_protocol.results.json: O_EXCL empty reservation, one final write attempt and file.Sync; no overwrite or automatic retry
output_protocol.stdout: exact successful final bytes; stdout or close failure does not erase a retained final
output_protocol.external_kill: cannot invoke finalization; without finalized completion receipt, surviving complete journal rows do not prove Sync returned; final complete-row acknowledgment unknown
output_protocol.completed_state: refuses completed final after either report or writer sticky failure; does not silently serialize completed with stopped=true
